cross_cutting.scope: Potentially every source. Fence new local administration and join supported owners; unaccounted producers abort before partition writes. Target-computer HID/BIOS/terminal autonomy is not local NanoKVM administration.
Disable legacy preserve/marker import and permission fixups for authenticated restore; do not trust old p3 trees.
Update front-end admission is implemented, not retained raw writer ownership. Disable/join respawners before stopping producers; service stop exit alone is insufficient.

writers: enrolled DNS/IPv6/Wi-Fi APIs and serialized WOL cache edits/optional history
unenrolled kvm_system AP and Wi-Fi state machine
enrolled firewall set/confirm/TLS downgrade and owned rollback stop/join
enrolled time set/sync and syslog set file/service chains
unenrolled independent init/native daemon producers; multi-file recovery still open
privileged sessions and operator SSH configuration

dynamic_inputs.readset: Exact active config path, logical cwd, effective startup Config, configured account/session-secret/cert/key paths. Canonical destination names are not the live source paths. Pending identity/layout changes require ordinary restart, not silent selection.

writers: owned API Wi-Fi credential/request publication, not native completion
dynamic_inputs.readset: AppState composed drain closes admission before firewall rollback stop/join; orphan/failed state aborts, not implicit confirmation. Wi-Fi API publication can drain while its marker is still pending; stop/join the independent consumer and settle the attempt before capture. Production capture integration, other reboot/raw/app owners and durable firewall recovery remain open. tmp/p3 markers are not restore authority.
Resolve actual selected Picoclaw home/config/workspace and installed optional runtime provenance. Do not infer default-home coverage or silently discard unsupported state.

Authoritative DNS/time/syslog settings must cover legacy defaults/fallback layouts before regenerating signed-image runtime defaults. resolv.conf/localtime/ntp/default shell files are not copied as arbitrary links or executable authority; missing canonicalization must fail preflight.

constraints: Coverage is a source review inventory, never a quiescence receipt, runtime authorization or product acceptance.

source_basis records a reviewed revision, not a checked Git/content binding. Evidence is checked for file existence only; writer/status/readset statements require manual review. Tree roots do not enumerate descendants, and unchanged restore paths do not prove that no new producer exists.
All groups inherit cross-cutting writers; enrolled means only the named API domain has a permit, not that every producer for those paths has stopped.
Stop respawners first, close new writer admission, finish or phase-aware cancel/join existing work, join service/helper owners, then capture; retain ownership through capsule sealing and raw handoff.

Do not assume cgroups/freezer/PID namespaces from a Linux version number; verify exact deployed kernel capabilities before choosing a maintenance mechanism. No kernel change is authorized by this inventory.
S96picoclaw and S98tailscaled are conditional optional runtime services, not default Buildroot-installed init entries. Presence in source is not evidence they run on a device.
Rust hwmon writes tmp telemetry, not the preserved allowlist; syslog/klogd log output and file-backed media data are not preserved configuration. They may still need lifecycle stop for raw overwrite.

Native vendor-library side effects and arbitrary privileged local code are not proven bounded by lexical path searches. Unknown ownership aborts capture; do not claim process-tree closure from pidfile removal or killall success.
